authority_notes.coherent_simulation: RESEARCH. `any_td` is the ONLY statistic with a non-zero deployed reconciliation weight (0.25); every other family deploys at 0, so its reconciled probability sits at the MARKET mean with the football shape and is reported but never ranked.
